chunks: And the earth, how it was spread out?
ai.seo_question: How was the earth spread out according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this rhetorical question invites contemplation on the divine engineering that stabilized the earth for human habitation, serving as a tangible proof of God's omnipotence. It underscores the concept of 'tawhid' in creation, where the physical stability of the world points directly to the singular, all-powerful Creator who orchestrated its expansion.
